description:
2000W Dual Motor Powerful Ebike: 48V 1000W brushless Front Motor and 1000W Rear Motor total 2000W, under pure electric mode the 1000W high-speed brush-less Shimano 7-speed gear motor can help you easy ride max speed up to 28mph. It is an all-terrain ebike that can cycling on snow, mountains, roads, beaches, etc. Easy to assemble and with high quality.

High-perfromance Lithium Battery: Our electric bike equipped with 48V 18AH detachable lithium battery, Easy to carry and easy to disassemble. It is designed with waterproof package. The battery can be charged directly or it can be removed for charging. Charging time: about 4-6 hours, 2000 cycles of charging.

Excellent Performance In 3 Riding Models:- Pure electric mode(35-45km battery range); Pure manpower mode; Pedal assist mode(60-90km battery range); Customize your ride performance with 3 riding modes and Shimano 7-speed，you can enjoy cycling in each mode. Support 180kg(396LBS). Suitable height between 165cm (65in) and 195cm (77in). The perfect disc brakes and lighting system fully protect your safety. Better shock absorption effect will bring you the best riding experience.

Large Color Screen Instrument & Headlight: LCD display computer makes it better for you to know clearly about the per hour speed and the whole distance you have ridden, and also you can know the battery remaining capacity of your bike. Big super bright led headlight helps you ride safer at night.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: Our Retro Cargo Electric Bike comes with tail light + basket + fender + lock + pump + mobile phone holder; with 12 months warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. We offer customers 24 hours Quickly Response. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns.
